text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 1134, "unit": "miles", "kind": "count", "span": "flew 1,134 miles on Tuesday"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 1475, "unit": "miles", "kind": "count", "span": "1,475 miles on Thursday"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 3, "unit": "weeks", "kind": "count", "span": "flies the same number of miles 3 weeks in a row"}], "plan": [{"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "Tuesday miles plus Thursday miles = miles flown that week"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s1", "q3"], "out": "s2", "note": "miles per week times number of weeks"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "total miles flown over the 3 weeks"}, "dismissed": []}
